title: Dialog
description: A modal window over the page, with a header, a body that scrolls when it outgrows the screen, and a footer for actions such as save and cancel.

components.Dialog: Groups all parts of the dialog.
components.DialogBody: Holds the dialog's main content and scrolls it when the dialog outgrows the screen, keeping the header and footer in view.
components.DialogContent: Holds what the dialog shows while open.
components.DialogDescription: Explains the purpose of the dialog below its title.
components.DialogFooter: Holds the actions of the dialog, such as confirm and cancel buttons.
components.DialogHeader: Groups the title and description at the top of the dialog.
components.DialogOverlay: Covers the page behind the open dialog.
components.DialogScrollContent: Holds what the dialog shows while open, scrolling when the content is tall.
